findings.evidence: In the end frame, the arrow from the highlighted sheet row stops at the top edge of the n8n window rather than at the lightning-bolt node. That node is labeled only “Trigger,” leaving the new-row operation unspecified.
findings.suggestion: Route the connector to the trigger node and label it “Google Sheets Trigger,” with “New row” as a short secondary label, to make the row-to-trigger relationship explicit.

findings.evidence: In both frames, “Trigger” and “HTTP Request” sit close together on one baseline, and “HTTP Request” extends beneath the separate check-mark node, making its node association ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Center each operation label beneath its corresponding node, wrap “HTTP Request” onto two lines, and leave clear spacing before the check-mark node.
